title: AI-Powered Document Analyzer
summary: A personal project: a Streamlit app that summarises uploaded PDFs and answers questions about them using Gemini.
overview: A web application where users upload a PDF and get a short summary, a long summary, or answers to their own questions about the document.
problem: Long PDFs are slow to read. Summaries and question answering let a reader get to the relevant content faster.
approach: PDF text is extracted with PyPDF2.
A generative AI model (Gemini) produces short and long summaries and answers questions.
A Streamlit interface supports drag-and-drop upload.

architecture.label: Model
architecture.detail: Gemini generates the summaries and answers.

architecture.label: Handling of long or scanned documents
architecture.detail: Not specified; no OCR is documented.

workflow.step: Text is extracted from the PDF.
The user chooses a short summary, a long summary or asks a question, and the model responds.

items: Built this personal project, per the public repository.

limitations: Details come from the project's public README on GitHub; no usage numbers, accuracy figures or deployment results are claimed.
